title: Minecraft BEST Sugar Cane Farm 1.21 - New - 15000+ Per Hour!
description:
TheySix is here with a new Minecraft tutorial, In this Tutorial I Will Show you how to make a Simple Easy Auto Harvester Flying Machine For Sugar Cane Farms In Minecraft 1.21

📚This Auto Harvester Flying Machine is simple easy to build and so extremely fast this farm can produce + 3000 ~ +15000 - Or Higher Sugar Canes Per Hour ! ( The farm rate depends on the range and number of machines that you have )
📚Don't leave ( close ) when this flying machine is working otherwise your flying machine will be stopped
📚This farm will work on java, not bedrock 
📚 If you want to produce more than +3000 or higher than 15000 per hour,  just add more flying machines, there is no limit.
📚the farm rate is based on the range of 100 blocks

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
